events.name: Tick
events.description: Raised each time Interval milliseconds have passed while the timer is enabled. It runs on the UI thread.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Update a clock, refresh data, or run a delayed action.

events.name: DoWork
events.description: Raised on a background thread when RunWorkerAsync is called. Do not touch controls here.
events.argumentsNote: e.Argument is the value passed to RunWorkerAsync, e.Result is how you return a result, e.Cancel = true marks the work as cancelled.
events.useCase: Run the slow work: copy files, process data, call a service.

events.name: ProgressChanged
events.description: Raised on the UI thread when the worker calls ReportProgress.
events.argumentsNote: e.ProgressPercentage is the number passed to ReportProgress (0 to 100), e.UserState is an optional extra object.
events.useCase: Move a progress bar and update a status label.

events.name: RunWorkerCompleted
events.description: Raised on the UI thread when the work finishes, fails or is cancelled.
events.argumentsNote: e.Error is the exception if the work failed, e.Cancelled is true if it was cancelled, e.Result is the value set in DoWork.
events.useCase: Report the outcome and re-enable the Start button.

events.name: MouseClick
events.description: Raised when the tray icon is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.Button tells which mouse button was used, e.Location the position.
events.useCase: Restore the window when the user clicks the tray icon.

events.name: MouseDoubleClick
events.description: Raised when the tray icon is double-clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.Button tells which mouse button was used.
events.useCase: Open the main window, as many tray applications do.

events.name: BalloonTipClicked
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the balloon notification.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Open the item the notification is about.

events.name: BalloonTipClosed
events.description: Raised when the balloon notification disappears.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Clean up or update the status after a notification.
